title: New Product Launch Video and Photos | AIVideosUGC
description: Create launch videos and photos from one product image. Make a short preview, a reveal, and a listing photo before launch day. No studio booking or reshoot.
h1: Create Your Product Launch Video and Photos Fast
lead: Paste a product link and get a script, an actor, and a voice for a short teaser. A teaser is a preview you post before the date is public.

faq.q: How many credits does a launch photo or video use?
faq.a: Credits are what each photo or video uses. A photo uses 24 credits. A video uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. You see the cost before you start. If it fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Can I change the timer on the launch video?
faq.a: Yes. Set the end time in the editor and move it if the day changes. You decide when the countdown stops.

faq.q: Will anyone else see my unreleased product?
faq.a: No. The upload and the result stay in your account, and they are not published until you share them.

faq.q: What shape should the launch video use?
faq.a: A product photo is square. For a phone video on Stories, Reels, or TikTok, use tall 9:16. Use square 1:1 for a square post, wide 16:9 for a wide page, or 4:3 and 3:4 when the spot needs them. Each video is a separate run.

faq.q: How long can the launch clip be?
faq.a: Clips run 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Six seconds fits a quick reveal. Use 15 or 30 seconds when the launch needs a fuller product story.

faq.q: Can the countdown use an actor from the library?
faq.a: Yes. Pick one, describe the look and the outfit, or build one from a short clip of you. That person is generated, not a real customer or a celebrity.

faq.q: Can I bring my own product clip into the countdown?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the clip or the photo you already have. It can sit next to the actor, the script, and the timer.

faq.q: Can I make launch videos for many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. You can run many product links at once, and each one comes back as its own countdown. Check every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can my own tools request launch videos?
faq.a: Yes. An API is a connection that lets your own tools ask for a countdown from a product link. The file stays in your account until you share it.

faq.q: Can I add a spoken voice, music, and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI voice, set the pace, pick a track from the music library, and turn on captions (the words on screen). The same script can be spoken in another language.

faq.q: Can I publish the short preview to TikTok or Meta?
faq.a: Yes. Publish in one click to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or Meta, or download the file. Meta here means Facebook and Instagram. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark. Each app still has its own ad rules.

faq.q: Can I change the launch date after the video is made?
faq.a: Yes. Move the timer or the date line in the editor, so a new day does not mean a new scene.
